title: Hear from people who have sat with Priya.
intro: All 47 Google reviews, in the words they left on the listing.

faq.title: About the reviews
faq.intro: What people ask after they have read a few.

items.a: Yes. They are the Google reviews left on the Divine Souls listing. You can read the same words on Google.

items.q: Can I leave a review if I sat with her?
items.a: Yes. Use Rate us on Google after the sitting. A few honest lines is enough.

items.q: Why do some reviews mention Surat?
items.a: Some people sat with her there earlier. The practice is in Dehradun now. The work is the same.

items.q: Do I have to be in Dehradun to sit?
items.a: No. A lot of the work can be held at a distance. Say which you need when you write.

items.q: How do I book after reading these?
items.a: WhatsApp +91 7668648224, email priyasinha1809@gmail.com, or use the contact page. You do not have to name a sitting first.

cards.title: Write to sit

cards.title: Prefer WhatsApp?
cards.body: The same note, sent there. She will take it from there.
